purpose: Classify the already-sealed Step 4A bucket-close book_crossed booleans by frozen market segment and state and issue exactly one bounded recertify-or-reject recommendation.

temporal_grid.bucket_index_rule: 0 through 86399 exactly once in increasing order
temporal_grid.bucket_timestamp_rule: start equals day_start plus bucket_index times one second; end equals start plus one second

per_payload: verify exact payload hash, byte size, row count, full schema column count, and allowed-column presence before row access
read exactly and only the seven allowed columns
verify complete unique ordered bucket grid and exact segment/state labels
verify book_crossed is non-null for all 86,400 buckets
verify every crossed bucket has a non-null state_source_row_ordinal
count total buckets and crossed buckets separately by segment_id
count total buckets and crossed buckets separately by market_state
sum crossed buckets in CONTINUOUS_00_22 and CONTINUOUS_23_24 as continuous_crossed_bucket_closes
reproduce the sealed total of 60 crossed bucket closes
calculate a complete selected-column stream checksum
calculate a crossed-bucket identity checksum without emitting raw state_source_row_ordinal
classification_tests.crossed_bucket_identity_hash: For each crossed row in bucket order, SHA-256 the payload-independent canonical tuple bucket_index, bucket_start_ns, bucket_end_ns, market_segment, market_state, book_crossed, and state_source_row_ordinal; then SHA-256 the ordered concatenation of those row hashes.

independent_reproduction.primary: Sequential row scanner with fixed segment/state counters and streaming identity digests.
independent_reproduction.reference: Independent column-vector validation followed by separately coded boolean-mask classification and canonical identity hashing.
identical_required: total bucket counts by segment and state
crossed bucket counts by segment and state

zero_continuous_crossed_bucket_closes.recommendation_text: In a separately authorized amendment, permit BAD_TS_RECV only for rows satisfying the Step 4A.1 confirmed snapshot semantics; apply the crossed-book integrity gate only to CONTINUOUS_MATCHING one-second bucket-close states; report PRE_OPEN and MAINTENANCE crossed states separately without treating them as continuous-state failures; keep every other Step 4A definition and gate unchanged.

one_or_more_continuous_crossed_bucket_cl.recommendation_text: Reject the current Step 4A as-of-state construction for research use; do not repair it on the engineering date.

permitted: bucket counts by segment and state
prohibited: prices, depths, sizes, counts, spreads, midpoints, microprices, imbalances, event flows, or other feature values
outcomes, signals, execution, trades, or PnL

status_rules.FAIL_PREDECESSOR_OR_PAYLOAD_INTEGRITY: A predecessor seal, feature payload hash, byte size, row count, schema, or allowed column differs.
status_rules.FAIL_DISPOSITION_INTEGRITY: A grid, segment, state, boolean-completeness, identity, sealed-count, allowed-access, recommendation-count, or prohibited-work gate fails.
status_rules.FAIL_DISPOSITION_REPRODUCTION: The independent payload classifications differ on any frozen required output.
status_rules.PASS_DISPOSITION_REPRODUCTION: Every frozen integrity and independent-reproduction gate passes and the binary recommendation is recorded without implementation.

prohibited: modifying or relabeling Step 4A, Step 4A.1, or any earlier artifact or verdict
reading any feature column outside the seven-column allowlist
accessing MBO or MBP source rows
accessing or reporting market values or other feature values
repairing, filtering, or rerunning the feature pipeline
testing outcomes, signals, candidates, or relationships
trades, PnL, R multiples, or account returns
completion_policy: Record the exact segment/state counts, independently reproduce them, issue exactly one binary recommendation, document and seal Step 4A.2, and stop without implementation.
